page.content:
Ides of March, 44 BCE, in the Theatre of Pompey.

How Assassination of Caesar connects

  • Character: Julius Caesar — The Ides of March killed Caesar.
  • Location: Roman Forum — Caesar's funeral in the Forum turned the city against the Liberators.

What is Assassination of Caesar?

The Liberators killed Caesar to restore the Republic. The funeral, Octavian's arrival, and the next civil war showed that the dictatorship had already remade politics.

Key threads lead to Julius Caesar and Roman Forum.
